newsitem.title: USA: Cohesant Technologies Inc Q3 net, shr drop.
newsitem.headline: Cohesant Technologies Inc Q3 net, shr drop.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: The company said improved sales for the third quarter of fiscal 1996 compared with the same period last year were due to increased sales of epoxy coating systems, incident to the acquisition of Raven Lining Systems in December 1995.

NOTE: In the comparisons between the third quarters of fiscal 1996 and fiscal 1995 the company said gross profit increased but operating income decreased because of increased operating expenses, particularly for the operation of the Raven subsidiary and legal fees associated with Glas-Craft subsidiary's patent infringement lawsuit, settled in September 1996.
